179: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
180: {
181: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
182: 
183: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
184: 
185: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
189: 	{
190: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
191: 	}
192: 	else
193: 	{
194: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}
264: 
265: rx_isr_data_xit:
266: 	
267: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
268: 	{
269: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
273: 
274: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
275: 
276: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
277: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
278: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
279: 	 */
280: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
281: 
282: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
283: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
284: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
285: 
286: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
287: 	{
288: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
289: 		{
290: 			/* trigger send! */
291: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 	
295: 	return;
296: }

298: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
299: {

306: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!

326: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
327: {
328: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
329: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
330: 	
331: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
332: 	{
333: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
334: 	}
335: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
336: 	{
337: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
338: 	}
339: 	else
340: 	{
341: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
342: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
343: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
344: 		 */
345: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
346: 
347: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
348: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
349: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
350: 	}
351: 	
352: 	return;
353: }

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

427: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
428: {
429: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
430: 
431: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
432: 		return BK_OK;
433: 
434: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
435: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
436: 
437: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
438: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
439: 
440: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
441: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
442: 	{
443: 		return BK_FAIL;
444: 	}
445: 
446: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
447: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
448: 	{
449: 		return ret_code;
450: 	}

452: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);

480: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
483: 
484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
485: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
486: 
487: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
488: 	{
489: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
493: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
494: 
495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
515: 	{
516: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
517: 	}
518: 	else
519: 	{
520: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
521: 
522: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
523: 		{
524: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
525: 		}
526: 		else
527: 		{
528: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
529: 
530: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
535: 
536: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
537: 
538: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
539: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
540: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
541: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
542: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
543: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
544: 
545: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
546: 
547: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (rd_idx + cpy_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	return ret_val;
553: }

555: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)

628: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
629: {
630: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
631: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
632: 	
633: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
634: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
635: 
636: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
637: 	{
638: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
643: 	}
644: 
645: 	wr_len = data_len;
646: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
647: 		wr_len = rem_len;
648: 
649: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
650: 	{
651: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
652: 	}
653: 	else
654: 	{
655: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
656: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
657: 
658: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
659: 		{
660: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
661: 		}
662: 		else
663: 		{
664: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
665: 
666: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
671: 
672: 	/* trigger send! */
673: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
674: 
675: 	return wr_len;
676: }

678: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
679: {
680: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
681: 
682: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
683: 		return 0;
684: 
685: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
686: 
687: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
688: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
689: 
690: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
691: 	{
692: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
693: 	}
694: 	else
695: 	{
696: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
697: 	}
698: 
699: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
700: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
701: 		rd_len = buf_len;
702: 
703: 	if(rd_len == 0)
704: 	{
705: 		return 0;
706: 	}
707: 
708: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
709: 	{
710: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
711: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
712: 	}
713: 	else
714: 	{
715: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
716: 
717: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
718: 		{
719: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
720: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
721: 		}
722: 		else
723: 		{
724: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
725: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
726: 			{
727: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
728: 			}
729: 
730: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
731: 		}
732: 	}
733: 
734: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
735: 
736: 	/* rts assert...... */
737: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
738: 	{
739: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
740: 		{
741: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
742: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
743: 		}
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	return rd_len;
747: 
748: }

137: static u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
138: {
139: 	u8    crc = 0x00;
140: 
141: #if MB_UART_CRC8_ENABLE

143: 	{
144: 		crc = crc8_table[crc ^ data_buf[i]];
145: 	}
146: #endif
147: 
148: 	return (crc);
149: }

179: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
180: {
181: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
182: 
183: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
184: 
185: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
189: 	{
190: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
191: 	}
192: 	else
193: 	{
194: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}
264: 
265: rx_isr_data_xit:
266: 	
267: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
268: 	{
269: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
273: 
274: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
275: 
276: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
277: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
278: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
279: 	 */
280: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
281: 
282: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
283: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
284: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
285: 
286: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
287: 	{
288: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
289: 		{
290: 			/* trigger send! */
291: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 	
295: 	return;
296: }

298: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
299: {
300: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
301: 
302: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
303: 
304: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
305: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
306: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
307: 	 */
308: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
309: 
310: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
311: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 0;
312: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
313: 
314: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
315: 	{
316: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
317: 		{
318: 			/* trigger send! */
319: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
320: 		}
321: 	}
322: 
323: 	return;
324: }

326: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
327: {
328: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
329: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
330: 	
331: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
332: 	{
333: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
334: 	}
335: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
336: 	{
337: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
338: 	}
339: 	else
340: 	{
341: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
342: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
343: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
344: 		 */
345: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
346: 
347: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
348: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
349: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
350: 	}
351: 	
352: 	return;
353: }

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

427: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
428: {
429: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
430: 
431: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
432: 		return BK_OK;
433: 
434: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
435: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
436: 
437: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
438: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
439: 
440: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
441: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
442: 	{
443: 		return BK_FAIL;
444: 	}
445: 
446: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
447: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
448: 	{
449: 		return ret_code;
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
453: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
454: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
455: 
456: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
457: 
458: 	return BK_OK;
459: }

461: static bk_err_t mb_uart_deinit(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
462: {
463: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
464: 		return BK_OK;

466: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, NULL);

473: 	chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback = NULL;
474: 
475: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 0;
476: 
477: 	return BK_OK;
478: }

480: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
483: 
484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
485: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
486: 
487: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
488: 	{
489: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
493: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
494: 
495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
515: 	{
516: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
517: 	}
518: 	else
519: 	{
520: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
521: 
522: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
523: 		{
524: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
525: 		}
526: 		else
527: 		{
528: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
529: 
530: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
535: 
536: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
537: 
538: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
539: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
540: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
541: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
542: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
543: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
544: 
545: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
546: 
547: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (rd_idx + cpy_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	return ret_val;
553: }

555: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
556: {
557: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
558: 
559: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
560: 	{
561: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
562: 		return BK_OK;
563: 	}
564: 
565: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
566: 
567: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
568: 
569: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
570: 
571: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
572: 
573: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
574: 	{
575: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
576: 	}
577: 
578: 	return ret_val;
579: }

218: 		return 1;
219: 
220: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
221: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
222: 
223: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
224: 
225: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
226: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
227: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
228: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
229: 
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
231: 
232: 	__DMB();
233: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
234: 
235: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
236: 
237: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
238: 
239: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
240: 	{
241: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
242: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
243: 
244: 		return 2;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
248: 
249: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
250: 
251: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
252: 	{
253: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	return 0;
257: }

259: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
260: {
261: 	u8		log_chnl;
262: 	u8		ret_code;
263: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
264: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
265: 
266: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
267: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
268: 
269: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
272: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
273: 
274: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
275: 
276: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
277: 		return;
278: 
279: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
280: 		return;
281: 
282: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
283: 		return;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
286: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
287: 
288: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
289: 		return;
290: 
291: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
292: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
293: 	{
294: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
295: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
296: 
297: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
298: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
299: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
300: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
301: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
302: 		{
303: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
304: 			u8  i;
305: 
306: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
308: 
309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
310: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
311: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
312: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
313: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
314: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
315: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
316: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
317: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
318: 					}
319: 					break;
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
335: 
336: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
337: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
341: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
342: 	{
343: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
356: 
357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
361: 
362: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
363: 
364: 	if(ret_code != 0)
365: 	{
366: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
369: 	}
370: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
371: 
372: 	return;
373: 
374: }

376: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
377: {
378: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
379: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
380: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
381: 	u16 		chnl_type;
382: 
383: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
384: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
385: 
386: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
387: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
392: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
393: 
394: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
395: 		return;
396: 
397: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
398: 		return;
399: 
400: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
401: 		return;
402: 
403: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
404: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
405: 
406: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
407: 
408: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
411: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
412: 
413: 		return;
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
417: 	{
418: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
419: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
420: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
421: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
422: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
423: 
424: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
425: 
426: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
427: 	}
428: 	else
429: 	{
430: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
434: 	{
435: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
436: 		return;
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
440: 
441: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
442: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
443: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
444: 
445: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
446: 
447: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
448: 
449: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
450: 
451: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
452: 	{
453: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
454: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
455: 
456: 		return;
457: 	}
458: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
459: 	return;
460: }

462: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
463: {
464: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
465: 
466: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
467: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
468: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
469: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
470: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
471: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
472: 
473: 	/*
474: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
475: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
476: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
477: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
478: 	 */
479: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
480: 	{
481: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
482: 	}
483: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
484: 	{
485: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
486: 	}
487: }

489: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
490: {
491: 	u8		ret_code;
492: 
493: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
494: 
495: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
496: 
497: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
498: 
499: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
500: 		return;
501: 
502: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
503: 		return;
504: 
505: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
506: 
507: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
508: 	{
509: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
510: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
511: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
512: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
513: 
514: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
515: 
516: 		if(ret_code != 0)
517: 		{
518: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
519: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
520: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
521: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
522: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
523: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
524: 
525: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
526: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
527: 			}
528: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
529: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
530: 		}
531: 	}
532: 
533: 	return;
534: }

536: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
537: 
538: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
539: {
540: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
541: 	u16 			chnl_type;
542: 
543: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
544: 
545: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
546: 
547: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
548: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
549: 
550: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
551: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
552: 
553: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
554: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
555: 
556: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
557: 
558: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
559: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
560: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
561: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
562: 
563: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
564: 
565: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
566: 
567: 	/*
568: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
569: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
570: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
571: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
572: 	 */
573: 	while(1)
574: 	{
575: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
576: 
577: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
578: 		{
579: 			break;
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 
583: 	return ret_code;
584: }

586: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_reset(u8 dst_cpu)
587: {
588: 	u16 				chnl_type;
589: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	cmd_buf = {0};
590: 
591: 	if(SELF_CPU == dst_cpu)
592: 	{
593: 		return BK_OK;
594: 	}
595: 
596: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
597: 
598: 	cmd_buf.hdr.data = 0;
599: 	cmd_buf.hdr.ctrl |= (CHNL_CTRL_RESET | CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX);
600: 	cmd_buf.hdr.logical_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU);
601: 
602: 	bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)&cmd_buf, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
603: 
604: 	return BK_OK;
605: }

607: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
608: /*
609:   * init logical chnanel module.
610:   * return:
611:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
612:   *     failed  : fail code.
613:   *
614:   */
615: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
616: {
617: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
618: 	int				i, j;
619: 
620: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
621: 
622: 	/*
623: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
624: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
625: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
626: 	 * can race here:
627: 	 *
628: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
629: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
630: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
631: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
632: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
633: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
634: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
635: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
636: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
637: 	 *
638: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
639: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
640: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
641: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
642: 	 */
643: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
644: 	{
645: 		return BK_OK;
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
649: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
650: 	{
651: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
652: 		return BK_OK;
653: 	}
654: 
655: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
656: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
657: 	{
658: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
659: 
660: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
661: 
662: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
663: 
664: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
665: 		{
666: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
671: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
672: 	{
673: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
674: 		return ret_code;
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
678: 
679: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
680: 	{
681: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
682: 
683: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
684: 	}
685: 
686: 	mb_phy_chnl_reset(0);
687: 
688: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
689: 
690: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
691: 
692: 	return BK_OK;
693: }

695: /*
696:   * open logical chnanel.
697:   * input:
698:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to open.
699:   *     callback_param : param passsed to all callbacks.
700:   * return:
701:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
702:   *     failed  : fail code.
703:   *
704:   */
705: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param)
706: {
707: 	if(!mb_chnnl_init_ok)	/* if driver is not initialized. */
708: 	{
709: 		bk_err_t		ret_code;
710: 
711: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_init();
712: 
713: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
714: 		{
715: 			return ret_code;
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
720: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
721: 
722: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
723: 
724: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
725: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
726: 
727: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
728: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
729: 
730: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
731: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
732: 
733: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
734: 
735: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
736: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
737: 
738: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used)
739: 		return BK_ERR_OPEN;
740: 
741: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used = 1;		/* chnl in used. */
742: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param = callback_param;
743: 
744: 	return BK_OK;
745: }
746: 
747: /*
748:   * close logical chnanel.
749:   * input:
750:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to close.
751:   * return:
752:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
753:   *     failed  : fail code.
754:   *
755:   */
756: bk_err_t mb_chnl_close(u8 log_chnl)
757: {
758: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
759: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
760: 
761: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
762: 
763: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
764: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
765: 
766: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
767: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
768: 
769: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
770: 
771: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
772: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
773: 
774: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
775: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
776: 
777: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used = 0;
778: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
779: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = NULL;
780: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = NULL;
781: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = NULL;
782: 
783: 	return BK_OK;
784: }
785: 
786: /*
787:   * read from logical chnanel.
788:   * input:
789:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to read.
790:   *     read_buf       : buffer to receive channel cmd data.
791:   * return:
792:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
793:   *     failed  : fail code.
794:   *
795:   */
796: bk_err_t mb_chnl_read(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * read_buf)
797: {
798: 	return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
799: }
800: 
801: /*
802:   * write to logical chnanel.
803:   * input:
804:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
805:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
806:   * return:
807:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
808:   *     failed  : fail code.
809:   *
810:   */
811: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
812: {
813: 	u16		write_len;
814: 
815: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
816: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
817: 
818: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
819: 
820: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
821: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
822: 
823: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
824: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
825: 
826: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
827: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
828: 
829: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
830: 
831: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
832: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
833: 
834: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
835: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
836: 
837: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
838: 
839: 	/* If the physical channel has been BUSY abnormally long (peer never
840: 	 * sent ACK / lost interrupt / lost ack), forcibly recover it so this
841: 	 * and all future mb_chnl_write() calls on the channel don't deadlock. */
842: 	{
843: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy_cb_chk = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
844: 
845: 		if ((phy_cb_chk->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY) && (phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms != 0))
846: 		{
847: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
848: 			u32 age = now - phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms;	/* unsigned wrap is fine for short windows */
849: 
850: 			if (age >= MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS)
851: 			{
852: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt++;
853: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;	/* mark "BUSY-stuck recovered" */
854: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
855: 				phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms = 0;
856: 			}
857: 		}
858: 	}
859: 
860: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
861: 	{
862: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
863: 
864: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
865: 	}
866: 
867: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
868: 
869: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
870: 
871: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
872: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
873: 	__DMB();
874: 
875: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
876: 
877: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
878: 
879: 	return BK_OK;
880: }
881: 
882: /*
883:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).
884:   * input:
885:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to set/get param.
886:   *     cmd          : control command for logical channel.
887:   *     param      :  parameter of the command.
888:   * return:
889:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
890:   *     failed  : fail code.
891:   *
892:   */
893: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)
894: {
895: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
896: 
897: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
898: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
899: 
900: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
901: 
902: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
903: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
904: 
905: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
906: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
907: 
908: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
909: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
910: 
911: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
912: 
913: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
914: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
915: 
916: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
917: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
918: 
919: 	switch(cmd)
920: 	{
921: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
922: 
923: 			if(param == NULL)
924: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
925: 
926: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
927: 			
928: 			break;
929: 
930: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
931: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
932: 			break;
933: 
934: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
935: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
936: 			break;
937: 
938: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
939: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
940: 			break;
941: 
942: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
943: 			if(param == NULL)
944: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
945: 
946: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
947: 			return ret_code;
948: 			break;
949: 
950: 		default:
951: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
952: 			break;
953: 	}
954: 
955: 	return BK_OK;
956: }

28: 
29: /* If a physical channel stays BUSY longer than this (in milliseconds)
30:  * without seeing the matching ACK from the peer CPU, mb_chnl_write() will
31:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
32:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
33:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
34: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200
35: 
36: typedef struct
37: {
38: 	volatile u8		tx_state;	/* physical channel tx state. */
39: 	u8		tx_seq;				/* physical channel tx sequence. */
40: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
41: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;
42: 	u32		rx_fault_cnt;
43: 	u32		tx_fault_cnt;
44: 
45: 	u32		param1;
46: 	u32		param2;
47: 	u32		param3;
48: 	/* Wall-clock (ms via rtos_get_time()) at which tx_state was set to
49: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
50: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
51: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
52: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;
53: } mb_phy_chnl_cb_t;
54: 
55: 
56: #define CHNL_CTRL_MASK			0xF
57: /*
58:  *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
59:  *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
60:  *  use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
61:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
62:  */
63: #define CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX		0x01
64: 
65: #define CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX		0x02
66: #define CHNL_CTRL_RESET			0x04
67: 
68: typedef union
69: {
70: 	struct
71: 	{
72: 		u32		cmd            : 8;
73: 		u32		state          : 4;
74: 		u32		ctrl           : 4;
75: 		u32		tx_seq         : 8;
76: 		u32		logical_chnl   : 8;
77: 	} ;
78: 	u32		data;
79: } phy_chnnl_hdr_t;

82: {
83: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t	hdr;
84: 
85: 	u32		param1;
86: 	u32		param2;
87: 	u32		param3;
88: } mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t;
89: 
90: typedef struct
91: {
92: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t	hdr;
93: 
94: 	u32		data1;
95: 	u32		data2;
96: 	u32		data3;
97: } mb_phy_chnl_ack_t;
98: 
99: typedef union
100: {
101: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t		phy_ch_hdr;
102: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	phy_ch_cmd;
103: 	mb_phy_chnl_ack_t	phy_ch_ack;
104: 	mailbox_data_t		mb_data;
105: } mb_phy_chnl_union_t;
106: 
107: typedef struct
108: {
109: 	volatile u8		tx_state;				/* logical channel tx state. */
110: 	u8				in_used;
111: 	chnl_rx_isr_t		rx_isr;
112: 	chnl_tx_isr_t		tx_isr;
113: 	chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t	tx_cmpl_isr;

116: } mb_log_chnl_cb_t;

118: #define PHY_CHNL_NUM		SYSTEM_CPU_NUM

120: static mb_phy_chnl_cb_t		phy_chnl_x_cb[PHY_CHNL_NUM];
121: static mb_log_chnl_cb_t		log_chnl_cb0[CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_START];
122: static mb_log_chnl_cb_t		log_chnl_cb1[CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_START];
123: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 2
124: static mb_log_chnl_cb_t		log_chnl_cb2[CP2_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP2_MB_LOG_CHNL_START];
125: #endif

131: 	ARRAY_SIZE(log_chnl_cb0),
132: 	ARRAY_SIZE(log_chnl_cb1),
133: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 2
134: 	ARRAY_SIZE(log_chnl_cb2),
135: #endif
136: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 3
137: 	ARRAY_SIZE(log_chnl_cb3),
138: #endif
139: //	CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_START, 
140: 	};

143: 	&log_chnl_cb0[0],

148: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 3
149: 	&log_chnl_cb3[0], 
150: #endif
151: 	};

182: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_cnt = 0;
183: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt = 0;
184: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt = 0;
185: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt = 0;
186: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask = 0;

188: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
189: {
190: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
191: 	
192: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
193: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
194: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
195: 	
196: 	return ret_code;
197: }

199: 
200: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
201: {
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
203: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
204: 	u16 			chnl_type;
205: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
206: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
207: 
208: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
209: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
210: 
211: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
212: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
213: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
214: 		return 4;
215: #endif
216: 
217: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
218: 		return 5;
219: 
220: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
221: 		return 3;
222: 
223: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
224: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
225: 
226: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
227: 		return 1;
228: 
229: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
231: 
232: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
233: 
234: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
235: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
236: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
237: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
238: 
239: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
240: 
241: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
242: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
243: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
244: 
245: 	__DMB();
246: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
247: 
248: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
249: 
250: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
251: 
252: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
253: 	{
254: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
255: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
256: 
257: 		return 2;
258: 	}
259: 
260: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
261: 
262: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
263: 
264: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
265: 	{
266: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
267: 	}
268: 
269: 	return 0;
270: }
271: 
272: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
273: {
274: 	u8		log_chnl;
275: 	u8		ret_code;
276: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
277: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
278: 
279: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
280: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
281: 
282: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
283: 
284: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
285: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
286: 
287: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
288: 
289: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
290: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
291: 		return;
292: 	}
293: 
294: 
295: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
296: 	{
297: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: 
302: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
303: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
304: 		return;
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
308: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
309: 
310: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
311: 	{
312: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
313: 		return;
314: 	}
315: 
316: 	if(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
317: 	{
318: 		if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
319: 		{
320: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
321: 			return;
322: 		}
323: 
324: 		log_chnl -= log_chnl_idx;
325: 
326: 		ack_ptr->hdr.data = 0;
327: 		ack_ptr->hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
328: 		ack_ptr->hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
329: 
330: 		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
331: 
332: 		if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
333: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x20;
334: 			return;
335: 		}
336: 
337: 
338: 		extern bk_err_t bk_mailbox_ready(mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, uint32_t box_id);
339: 		if( bk_mailbox_ready(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx, MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL) != BK_OK)
340: 		{
341: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x40;
342: 			return;
343: 		}
344: 
345: 		// log_chnl = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl;
346: 		log_chnl += log_chnl_idx;  // don't change SRC-DST cpu-id, use only the chnl-id of tx_log_chnl.
347: 		if(log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl)
348: 		{
349: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x80;
350: 			return;
351: 		}
352: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"====mailbox reset!!%x, %x\r\n", log_chnl, phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
353: 		
354: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
355: 
356: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
357: 
358: 		ack_ptr->data1 = phy_chnl_ptr->param1;
359: 		ack_ptr->data2 = phy_chnl_ptr->param2;
360: 		ack_ptr->data3 = phy_chnl_ptr->param3;
361: 	}
362: 	else
363: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
364: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
365: 	{
366: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
368: 
369: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
370: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
371: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
372: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
373: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
374: 		{
375: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
376: 			u8  i;
377: 
378: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
379: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
380: 
381: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
382: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
383: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
384: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
385: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
386: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
387: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
388: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
389: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
390: 					}
391: 					break;
392: 				}
393: 			}
394: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
395: 		}
396: 		return;
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
400: 	{
401: 		/* clear following header members. */
402: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
403: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
404: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
405: 
406: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
407: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
408: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
409: 	} else {
410: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
414: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
415: 	{
416: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
417: 			break;
418: 	}
419: 
420: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
421: 	{
422: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
423: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
424: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
425: 		return;
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
429: 
430: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
431: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
432: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
433: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
434: 
435: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
436: 
437: 	if(ret_code != 0)
438: 	{
439: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
441: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
442: 	}
443: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
444: 
445: 	return;
446: 
447: }

449: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
450: {
451: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
452: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
453: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
454: 	u16 		chnl_type;
455: 
456: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
457: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
458: 
459: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
460: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
461: 
462: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
463: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
464: 
465: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
466: 
467: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
468: 		return;
469: 
470: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
471: 		return;
472: 
473: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
474: 		return;
475: 
476: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
477: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
478: 
479: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
480: 
481: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
482: 	{
483: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
484: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
485: 
486: 		return;
487: 	}
488: 
489: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
490: 	{
491: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
492: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
493: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
494: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
495: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
496: 
497: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
498: 
499: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
500: 	}
501: 	else
502: 	{
503: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
504: 	}
505: 
506: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
507: 	{
508: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
509: 		return;
510: 	}
511: 
512: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
513: 
514: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
515: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
516: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
517: 
518: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
519: 
520: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
521: 
522: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
523: 
524: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
525: 	{
526: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
527: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
528: 
529: 		return;
530: 	}
531: 
532: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
533: 	return;
534: }

536: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
537: {
538: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
539: 
540: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
541: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
542: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
543: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
544: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
545: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
546: 
547: 	/*
548: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
549: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
550: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
551: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
552: 	 */
553: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
554: 	{
555: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
556: 	}
557: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
558: 	{
559: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
560: 	}
561: }

563: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
564: {
565: 	u8		ret_code;
566: 
567: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
568: 
569: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
570: 
571: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
572: 
573: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
574: 		return;
575: 
576: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
577: 		return;
578: 
579: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
580: 
581: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
582: 	{
583: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
584: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
585: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
586: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
587: 
588: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
589: 
590: 		if(ret_code != 0)
591: 		{
592: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
593: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
594: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
595: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
596: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
597: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
598: 
599: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
600: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
601: 			}
602: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
603: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
604: 		}
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	return;
608: }

610: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
611: 
612: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
613: {
614: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
615: 	u16 			chnl_type;
616: 
617: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
618: 
619: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
620: 
621: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
622: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
623: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
624: #endif
625: 
626: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
627: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
628: 
629: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
630: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
631: 
632: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
633: 
634: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
635: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
636: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
637: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
638: 
639: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
640: 
641: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
642: 	
643: 	/*
644: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
645: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
646: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
647: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
648: 	 */
649: 	while(1)
650: 	{
651: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
652: 
653: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
654: 		{
655: 			break;
656: 		}
657: 	}
658: 
659: 	return ret_code;
660: }

663: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
664: /*
665:   * init logical chnanel module.
666:   * return:
667:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
668:   *     failed  : fail code.
669:   *
670:   */
671: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
672: {
673: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
674: 	int				i, j;
675: 
676: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
677: 
678: 	/*
679: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
680: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
681: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
682: 	 * can race here:
683: 	 *
684: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
685: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
686: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
687: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
688: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
689: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
690: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
691: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
692: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
693: 	 *
694: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
695: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
696: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
697: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
698: 	 */
699: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
700: 	{
701: 		return BK_OK;
702: 	}
703: 
704: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
705: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
706: 	{
707: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
708: 		return BK_OK;
709: 	}
710: 
711: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
712: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
713: 	{
714: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
715: 
716: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
717: 
718: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
719: 
720: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
721: 		{
722: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
723: 		}
724: 	}
725: 
726: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
727: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
728: 	{
729: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
730: 		return ret_code;
731: 	}
732: 
733: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
734: 
735: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
736: 	{
737: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
738: 
739: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
740: 	}
741: 
742: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
743: 
744: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
745: 
746: 	return BK_OK;
747: }

749: /*
750:   * open logical chnanel.
751:   * input:
752:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to open.
753:   *     callback_param : param passsed to all callbacks.
754:   * return:
755:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
756:   *     failed  : fail code.
757:   *
758:   */
759: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param)
760: {
761: 	if(!mb_chnnl_init_ok)	/* if driver is not initialized. */
762: 	{
763: 		bk_err_t		ret_code;
764: 
765: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_init();
766: 
767: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
768: 		{
769: 			return ret_code;
770: 		}
771: 	}
772: 
773: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
774: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
775: 
776: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
777: 
778: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
779: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
780: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
781: #endif
782: 
783: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
784: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
785: 
786: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
787: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
788: 
789: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
790: 
791: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
792: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
793: 
794: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used)
795: 		return BK_ERR_OPEN;
796: 
797: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used = 1;		/* chnl in used. */
798: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param = callback_param;
799: 
800: 	return BK_OK;
801: }

100: 						 line_length ? AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS : BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
101: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr)
102: 		{
103: 			ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);

117: 					line_length = 0;
118: 				}
119: 			}

以下结论基于 `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp` 当前源码和 `build/bk7258/app` 构建产物的只读交叉分析。这里的目录命名与 mailbox CPU ID 要特别区分：`ap` 代码定义自己为 `MAILBOX_CPU1`，`cp` 代码定义自己为 `MAILBOX_CPU0`。

**1. 通道编码和 UART0 方向**

- 通道号是 8 位：`bits[7:6]=dst_cpu`、`bits[5:4]=src_cpu`、`bits[3:0]=logical channel index`；提取宏和编码公式见 [AP mailbox_channel.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:32) 和 [CP mailbox_channel.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:29)。
- CPU endpoint 数值为 CPU0=0、CPU1=1、CPU2/DSP=2、BT=3，见 [mailbox_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_types.h:72)。
- AP：`SELF_CPU=CPU1`，CP0 通道组起点为 `(src=1,dst=0)=0x10`；UART0 是组内 index 9，因此 **AP `MB_CHNL_UART0=0x19`，方向 CPU1/AP → CPU0/CP**，见 [AP mailbox_channel.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:53) 和 [枚举](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:77)。
- CP：`SELF_CPU=CPU0`，CP1 通道组起点为 `(src=0,dst=1)=0x40`；UART0 同样为 index 9，因此 **CP `MB_CHNL_UART0=0x49`，方向 CPU0/CP → CPU1/AP**，见 [CP mailbox_channel.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:49) 和 [枚举](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:64)。
- 两侧数值不同是有意的：每一侧使用“本 CPU 为源”的逻辑通道号；接收时使用报文携带的发送方通道号反查源 CPU。

**2. 16 字节 logical/physical header 与状态机**

- Logical packet 固定 16 字节：word0 是 `mb_chnl_hdr_t`，word1/2/3 是 `param1/2/3`；ACK 同样是 word0 加 `ack_data1/2/3`，见 [AP mailbox_channel.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:109)。
- Logical word0 精确位域：`bits[7:0]=cmd`、`bits[11:8]=state`、`bits[31:12]=reserved`。当前 ARM32 little-endian 构建中，byte0=cmd，byte1 低半字节=state，其余为 reserved；little-endian ELF 由 [bk7258_ap_bsp.ld](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:22) 明确。
- Physical packet仍是16字节，但 word0 被扩展为：`bits[7:0]=cmd`、`[11:8]=state`、`[15:12]=ctrl`、`[23:16]=tx_seq`、`[31:24]=logical_chnl`，之后是三个 32 位数据字，见 [AP mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:52)。即 byte0=cmd，byte1=`ctrl<<4 | state`，byte2=sequence，byte3=logical channel。
- `ctrl` 位：bit0=`ACK_BOX`、bit1=`SYNC_TX`、bit2=`RESET`，见 [AP mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:59)。
- 普通 command：`mb_chnl_write()`复制完整16字节，标记 logical BUSY；物理通道空闲时标记 physical BUSY、递增8位 sequence、写入 physical metadata 并发送。硬件成功入队后 logical 立即变 IDLE，但 physical 要等 matching ACK 才变 IDLE，见 [写入](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:811) 和 [发送](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:194)。
- 接收 command：先复制16字节，按 `ACK_BOX` 区分 command/ACK；command 路径清除 physical metadata，只保留 `cmd` 给 logical RX callback。callback 原地把 command buffer 改成 ACK payload，随后 channel 层恢复原 physical header并加 `ACK_BOX`发送，见 [RX 分派](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:462) 和 [原地 ACK](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:416)。
- 没有 RX callback 时，ACK header 的 `state` 加 `CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL=1`；UART completion 将其视为传输失败，见 [无处理器语义](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:428)。
- ACK 必须同时匹配 `logical_chnl` 和 `tx_seq`；成功后调用 logical `tx_cmpl_isr`，再按低 logical index 优先级调度下一个 pending channel，见 [ACK 状态机](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:259)。
- `ACK_STATE_PENDING/COMPLETE/FAIL` 是应用层对 `ack_data3` 的约定，channel 层本身不解释，见 [ACK 枚举](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:129)；mb_uart 不使用该字段。
- Sync：设置 `SYNC_TX`、sequence=0，直接轮询发送；接收方调用 RX callback 后不回 ACK，见 [sync TX](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:538) 和 [sync RX](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:433)。如果 FIFO 永久 full，发送循环没有超时上限，会永久自旋。
- Reset：AP 初始化时向 CPU0 发送带 `RESET|ACK_BOX` 的特殊包，见 [AP reset](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:586) 和 [调用点](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:686)。CP 若正有发往 AP 的 physical TX，会用保存的 cmd/params 重建一个 `COM_FAIL` ACK，使该旧事务失败完成，见 [CP reset handler](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:316)。

**3. `mb_uart_cmd/rsp` 的 ARM32 每字节布局**

`mb_uart_cmd_t` 定义见 [mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:35)：

| Offset | Command 内容 |
|---|---|
| 0 | `cmd`：0=`SEND_DATA`，1=`SEND_STATE` |
| 1 | logical 时低4位 state；physical 时低4位 state、高4位 ctrl |
| 2 | physical `tx_seq` |
| 3 | physical `logical_chnl` |
| 4..7 | 32位 little-endian `cmd_buff` 指针 |
| 8..9 | little-endian `cmd_data_len` |
| 10 | bit0=`uart_rts`，bits7:1 reserved |
| 11 | CRC8 |
| 12..15 | union 为满足 `mb_chnl_cmd_t` 的尾部；代码未初始化，属于不确定/栈残留字节 |

- `mb_uart_rsp_t` 也是16字节：offset 0..3 为 header；offset4 bit0=`uart_rts`、bit1=`uart_tx_fail`、bit7:2 reserved；offset5..15 没有专门响应字段，通常保留接收 command 的旧内容，定义见 [mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:52)。
- 位域布局依赖当前 ARM GCC ABI；该协议直接传 C bitfield 和裸指针，并不是跨编译器、跨字节序或 ARM64 可移植格式。

**4. `mb_chnl_buff` 地址、大小、所有权与 cache**

- 每块 `MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN=128`；每 logical channel 分配 `host_tx[2][128] + host_rx[2][128] = 0x200`，映射顺序为 HW_CTRL、LOG、UART0、UART1，见 [mb_chnl_buff.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mb_chnl_buff.h:28) 和 [映射表](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_chnl_buff.c:29)。
- 当前构建 `.swap_data` 是双方共同的 **`0x2809f800..0x2809ffff`，共0x800/2048字节**，见 [ram_regions.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/bk7258/app/partitions/ram_regions.h:12)、[AP map](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/bk7258/app/bk7258_ap/app.map:33730) 和 [CP map](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/bk7258/app/bk7258/app.map:52612)。
- UART0：`host_tx[0]=0x2809fc00..fc7f`，`host_tx[1]=fc80..fcff`，`host_rx[0]=fd00..fd7f`，`host_rx[1]=fd80..fdff`。UART1 对应 `fe00..fe7f`、`fe80..feff`、`ff00..ff7f`、`ff80..ffff`。
- AP/CP 这一对使用 slot0：**CP 写 `0x2809fc00`、AP 读该块；AP 写 `0x2809fd00`、CP 读该块**。映射函数见 [TX ownership](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_chnl_buff.c:62) 和 [RX ownership](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_chnl_buff.c:98)。
- 当前 build 的 `CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE=false`，交换区由 MPU 配为 inner-shareable non-cacheable，见 [AP MPU](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:101) 和 [CP MPU](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/mpu_cfg.c:75)。若启用 cache，接收方会对 payload 执行 clean+invalidate，见 [UART RX cache](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:212) 和 [flush 实现](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/arch/cm33/cache.c:30)。

**5. UART data/state、RTS/CTS、ring 与 ACK/失败语义**

- 命令只有 `SEND_DATA=0` 和 `SEND_STATE=1`，见 [命令枚举](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:66)。DATA 指向128字节交换块；STATE 仅传 RTS，指针NULL、长度0。
- TX ring 实际数组129字节、可用容量128；RX ring数组257字节、可用容量256，均留一个空槽区分 full/empty，见 [控制块](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:99)。
- `uart_rts/status_cts` 保存的是线电平：注释称“低电平 asserted”。值0表示对端允许发送，值1表示 stop；`status_cts!=0` 时 TX 返回 BUSY，见 [CTS gate](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:480)。
- RX 剩余空间 `<=128` 时把本端 RTS 置1停止对端；应用读取后 occupancy `<102` 字节时重新置0并发送 STATE，形成约128/102字节滞回，见 [停止阈值](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:265) 和 [恢复阈值](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:734)。
- DATA ACK 的 `uart_tx_fail=1` 表示接收方整包丢弃，原因包括 RX ring 空间不足或 CRC 不符；overflow/parity 状态被 sticky 记录，`get_status()`读取后清零，见 [RX handler](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:179) 和 [status](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:953)。
- CRC 当前没有启用：宏被注释，计算函数恒定返回0，正常 payload corruption 不会被检测，见 [CRC 配置](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:29) 和 [计算函数](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:137)。
- TX 在 `mb_chnl_write()`仅“接受 command”后就推进 ring 读指针，见 [提前消费](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:545)。后续 `COM_FAIL`、远端 overflow/CRC fail 或 ACK 丢失均只打印 `Tx Failed!`，不会回滚、重传，也没有公开 TX-fail 状态；TX callback仍会被调用，见 [completion](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:355)。
- TX callback是“一个最多128字节 chunk或STATE完成”，不是整个用户 write 全部可靠送达；STATE 请求仅通过单个 `tx_state_req` 位合并。

**6. Init、deinit 和公开 API**

- `init` 清零控制块、取得两个交换块、打开 logical channel并注册 RX/TX-completion callback；重复 init 返回OK，见 [mb_uart_init](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:427)。
- 公共 `bk_mb_uart_dev_init()`无论内部 init 是否成功都会调用 `send_state_trigger()`，然后只返回原 init 结果，见 [公开 init](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:762)。
- `deinit` 注销 callback、关闭 logical channel并标记未初始化，但忽略所有 `mb_chnl_ctrl/close` 返回值，也不清 ring/状态或等待 pending TX；重复 deinit 返回OK，见 [deinit](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:461)。
- RX/TX ISR 注册要求设备已初始化；传NULL可注销用户 callback。write/read 对非法ID、未初始化、NULL或零长度统一返回0；write返回“放入本地 TX ring 的字节数”，不是远端确认数，见 [API 实现](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:788)。
- `write_ready`最大128，`read_ready`最大256；`is_tx_over()`对非法ID或未初始化返回true，正常时要求 ring空且`tx_in_process==0`，见 [ready/over](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:816)。
- 头文件声明了 `bk_mb_uart_dump()`，见 [mb_uart_driver.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h:168)，但 AP/CP 的 `.c` 均没有实现，调用会产生链接失败。
- `MB_UART2` 出现在公开枚举，但 channel数组只显式初始化 UART0/1；第三项隐式为0，最终会尝试 logical channel 0并失败，因此 UART2 实际不可用，见 [ID 枚举](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h:25) 和 [映射数组](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:756)。

**7. AP/CP 源一致性和关键 bug**

- `mb_uart_driver.c` AP/CP 字节级完全相同，SHA-256 均为 `d5e7c0e...e8e2933`；`mb_uart_driver.h`、`mb_chnl_buff.h`、`mbox0_adapter.c` 也分别字节级相同。`mb_chnl_buff.c`仅有空行/行号差异，语义相同。
- `mailbox_channel.h`必然不同，因为 AP=CPU1、CP=CPU0，通道值和方向不同。`mailbox_channel.c`也有实质差异：CP保存 param1..3 并实现 reset ACK 重建，AP负责发送 reset但没有 reset接收分支，见 [CP physical CB](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:36) 与 [AP physical CB](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:36)。
- **高风险：未验证共享指针/长度。** RX 注释要求 `cmd_buff==rx_xchg_buff`，实际只检查非NULL/非零，不验证指针、也不限制 `cmd_data_len<=128`；恶意或损坏的16字节 header 可导致任意地址 cache 操作和读取，或越过128字节交换块，见 [缺失校验处](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:197)。
- **高风险：ACK失败导致静默数据丢失。** TX ring在ACK前消费，任何远端 fail/通信 fail 都不重传；调用者得到的写入长度只表示本地入队。
- **明确 bug：init 的NULL检查重复检查 `tx_xchg_buff`，从不检查 `rx_xchg_buff`**，见 [mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:437)。
- **协议泄漏：command offset12..15未初始化；response offset5..15保留旧 command 内容。** 完整16字节仍被复制并跨核发送，可能泄漏发送方栈残留。
- **API缺口：** `bk_mb_uart_dump()`无实现；`MB_UART2`公开但不可工作；`status_frm_err`存在内部位但没有设置或公开状态位。
- **reset API不一致：** `MB_CHNL_TX_RESET`在头文件枚举和文档中公开，见 [mailbox_channel.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:158)，但两侧 `mb_chnl_ctrl()`都没有对应 case，只会返回 `BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT`。
- **Sync永久阻塞风险：** FIFO持续 full 时 `WRITE_SYNC`无限轮询，无重试上限、yield或peer-liveness判断。
- **UART层可能永久卡在 `tx_in_process=1`：** channel层200ms watchdog可释放 physical BUSY，但不会合成 UART completion；UART后续 write看到 `tx_in_process`仍为1只入ring而不重新触发，见 [watchdog](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:839) 和 [trigger gate](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:555)。
- **Mailbox v2双槽覆盖风险：** v2 adapter不是直接把16字节放硬件 FIFO，而是轮换两个静态16字节副本，FIFO只携带32位地址和长度16，见 [mbox0_adapter.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:11) 和 [发送路径](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:113)。硬件相关 FIFO 深度可达3，且 adapter忽略 command/ACK box参数；多个 sync/ACK并发入队时，第三次发送可覆盖尚未被接收方复制的第一槽内容。
- **并发契约不足：** TX/RX ring 的 memcpy和索引更新没有围绕完整操作加锁；单writer/单reader通常可工作，但多任务同时 write/read，以及 task与ISR间的严格内存发布顺序没有得到 API 层保证。
